svg.title: Research framework: empirical analysis and circular curation–expression feedback, version 2
svg.desc: White background and restrained, stronger blue and vermilion modules. Platform analysis occupies approximately 34 percent and simulation 66 percent of the main research area. The three open circular arcs are a schematic mechanism, not data proportions. The central card lies wholly inside the circle, while D, later R and utility output pass through deliberate gaps. Only successfully published posts return to the regime-specific pool. Reading updates same-type history independently of posting. Fixed author types and separate frozen inputs are retained. Chrysanthemums, memorial ribbon and candle indicate context only. No individual platform proportions are shown.
svg.text: Case-grounded author mix + B / D / R
3 regimes × 3 seeds · Interest-based interventions: B=0 / D=1 / R=1
Empirical patterns + simulated feedback → Public representation reorganization
